note: Declared development sample (G10_TRAINING.md section 4), not an official G9 weighting. It becomes development evidence once inspected. Prompt texts are not stored here: each slot points at a row of a pinned upstream file and holds the sha256 of its text. PROPOSED v2 (20 Nov 2026): v1's 55 resolved slots unchanged, 30 new slots resolved (20 API-Bank calls, 10 QASC questions), 15 indic slots still unavailable. It becomes the suite only when the lead signs the two licence rows; effort_manifest.json (v1) is not changed.

selection.pool: RL v1 candidates (local build of 11 Nov: code_contests non-Codeforces after decontam v2; hendrycks MATH train after decontam v2 and the MATH-500 13-gram guard)
selection.rule: lowest sha256(selection_seed:id) per stratum; code 8 aizu/7 atcoder/7 codechef/8 hackerearth; math 5 per level 1-5

api_bank.licence_file: api-bank/LICENSE (the repository root has a different licence)

A.note: 10-prompt canary, every label: first slot of each code judge and math level, plus the second aizu slot

C.cap: label budget + reply allowance, bounded by the real context
C.note: preregistered subset (first slot of each code judge, first slot of math levels 2 to 5); runs only with --stage C

training_exclusion.rule: These tasks are held out of every SFT/RL training artifact while this suite is in use; RL v1 must drop them before training. Run `effort_suite.py guard` on each training file.

selection_v2.rule: lowest sha256(selection_seed:id) over every candidate; QASC: one slot per distinct question text (validation split, 926 rows, 902 distinct questions), id = the row id; API-Bank: every API call in the level-1 dialogue files (lv1-lv2-samples/level-1-given-desc, files named *-level-1-*), at most one call per dialogue file and at most one call per API name, id = apibank/<file>#<line index>
